item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 13 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 13 #VISPRSD
Issued at 06:11 PM 16 August 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #NegrosOccidental(CityOfSipalay, Cauayan, Candoni, HinobaAn, BagoCity, LaCarlotaCity and Pontevedra) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Watch #VISPRSD
Issued at 10:00 AM 16 August 2026

Thunderstorm is MORE LIKELY to develop over #Cebu, #Bohol, #Siquijor, #NegrosOriental, #NegrosOccidental, #Iloilo, #Guimaras, #Antique, #Capiz, #Aklan, #Leyte, #SouthernLeyte, #Biliran, #EasternSamar, #Samar and #OccidentalMindoro within 12 hours.

All are advised to continue monitoring for updates.
